jobs.title: Business Operations - AI Builder
jobs.description:
WHAT WE DO

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.




WHO WE ARE

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.




WHO WE NEED

Rillet is looking for a Business Operations hire who builds with AI, not one who just talks about it. You'll work directly with function leaders across Sales, Partnership, Customer Success, and Deployment to rethink how their teams operate. You’ll drive real transformation in ways of working, not just automating small tasks, while also picking up core BizOps projects alongside the founders and Chief of Staff. This is a high-ownership role for someone who's already proven they can build: ideally time at a top consulting firm or investing shop (MBB, VC, PE) followed by a hands-on stint at a high-growth startup shipping AI-powered tools and processes.

We're looking for teammates who are based near our New York City or San Francisco offices, or open to relocating. Our hybrid schedule brings the team together in person on Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day each week. Some roles may spend more time in the office depending on the needs of the team.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Partner with function leaders to define AI transformation for their team.

 - Push for step-change transformation of ways of working, not just a pile of small automations.

 - Own execution end-to-end, from framing the problem to something the team runs on daily.

 - Drive adoption. The job's done when the team has genuinely changed how it works, not when something ships.

 - Work closely with AI engineering to leverage the broader AI infrastructure at Rillet.

 - Beyond AI, take on high-visibility BizOps projects that shape the company — prepping the investor reports, supporting expansion to new markets, running analysis on GTM performance and make improvement recommendations.




WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3 - 5 years of experience; time at a top-tier management consulting firm (MBB) or a VC/PE fund, followed by an operating role at a startup where you personally built AI-powered systems, tools, or processes — not just used AI as an end user.

 - Able to speak concretely to what you built: the problem, the approach, the tech stack, and the measured outcome.

 - Fluent with current AI tooling and moves fast to apply new capabilities to real workflows, not just aware of the news.

 - Highly organized, adaptable, and a natural problem-solver.

 - Thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with strong attention to detail.

 - Proven track record of taking initiative, navigating ambiguity, and delivering measurable results.

 - Action-oriented with a bias toward execution—you move quickly, take ownership, and aren’t afraid to pitch in beyond your core responsibilities.

 - Willingness to travel a few times yearly for team offsites, events, and gatherings.



The expected base salary range for this role is $110,000–$150,000 in New York City and San Francisco. Final compensation within this range will depend on factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and the scope of the role. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.

 

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com http://rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.






LIFE AT RILLET

 - Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

 - Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

 - Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

 - Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

As a Revenue Operations Manager on our Go-to-Market team, you will build and operate the systems, processes, and data infrastructure that power our revenue engine. You will partner closely with Sales, Finance, Customer Success, and Leadership to ensure our GTM organization scales efficiently as the business grows.

This is a highly cross-functional role with broad ownership across forecasting, Salesforce, commissions, CPQ, territory planning, lead routing, and GTM analytics. You'll build the operating systems that help our teams move faster, make better decisions, and deliver a world-class customer experience. Your work will directly influence how we scale revenue and execute against company goals.

Our hybrid schedule brings the team together in person on Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day each week.  - Own GTM forecasting, reporting, and operational planning, partnering with Sales and Finance to improve forecast accuracy and business visibility.

 - Design and optimize the systems, workflows, and governance that power our GTM organization, serving as the primary owner of Salesforce and our broader revenue technology stack.

 - Build scalable operational programs across commissions, CPQ, territory management, lead routing, and pipeline management to improve sales efficiency and execution.

 - Analyze revenue performance, pipeline health, and operational metrics to identify opportunities, inform strategic decisions, and drive continuous improvement.

 - Create enablement resources, documentation, and training that help our GTM teams adopt new processes and operate consistently as we scale.
   


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, or a related function in a high-growth SaaS company.

 - Deep experience administering Salesforce and designing scalable GTM processes, workflows, and reporting.

 - Strong analytical skills with experience building forecasts, dashboards, and operational reporting that influence executive decision-making.

 - Experience partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership.

 - Excellent project management and communication skills with a track record of driving operational initiatives from concept through execution.
   


BONUS POINTS

 - Experience implementing or managing CPQ, commissions, territory planning, or lead routing systems.

 - Experience supporting a fast-growing B2B SaaS organization from early growth through scale.

WHO WE NEED

In the Partnerships – PE/VC role, you will be a foundational member of one of Rillet’s most important growth functions.

You’ll own a book of private equity and venture funds and turn those relationships into pipeline, revenue, and long-term market advantage across their portfolios. The PE motion is one of the best performing channels at Rillet. Your job is to put fuel on the fire and drive maximum penetration across the ecosystem.

The playbook exists, but it is yet to be fully executed, and you will write the rest of it. You’ll own the number, design & run your own outbound, host the events, and represent Rillet to operating partners and CFOs without a chaperone. Your primary focus is reaching the portfolio companies behind each fund, but understanding the management company’s own needs is what earns you the right to get there. You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Solutions Consultants, Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and Rillet’s Accounting & Advisory Partnerships team to make your funds and their portcos successful.

One thing worth being direct about: this is not an account executive role, and it is not a sales development role. What you close is the partnership with the fund. You will have coverage to build real relationships while still letting you earn a high OTE.

We’re primarily looking for teammates within commutable distance of our San Francisco office, with New York considered for the right candidate, or those willing to relocate. Our hybrid schedule brings the team together in person Tuesdays through Thursdays. This role requires significant travel.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own a book of funds end to end. Open the conversation, multi-thread into operating and deal teams, and take each relationship from first touch through signed partnership and everything after.

 - Drive portfolio penetration. Convert fund relationships into introductions, pipeline, and closed customers across their portfolio companies – not just logos or a slot on a preferred vendor list.

 - Source & Influence opportunities. Work with investors to positively shape sales conversations when their portfolio companies come to Rillet, whether the partner made the introduction.

 - Host & Represent Rillet. Design and execute roughly two high-quality events a month, plus conferences, that senior leaders look forward to – and pull real relationships and insight out of them.

 - Build the infrastructure. Create repeatable go-to-market motions, enable the sales team to work productively with investor partners, and build the operating cadence that makes the channel scale.

 - Identify and execute on strategic initiatives. Work with funds on longer-term bets and ancillary opportunities beyond near-term revenue generation.

 - Raise the communication bar. Build exceptional pitches, partner materials, and outbound that earns a reply from people who delete most of their inbox.

 - Lead across Rillet. Partner closely with every function to ensure your funds’ and their portcos’ interests

The expected base salary range for this role is $120,000–$160,000 in New York City and San Francisco. Final compensation within this range will depend on factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and the scope of the role. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.
